responses.draft_cover_letter:
I bring extensive full‑stack experience that aligns directly with Tally Logistics’ tech stack. I have built and operated Node.js microservices for parcel‑tracking, deploying them on AWS ECS using Terraform, and I routinely work with TypeScript across both backend and frontend codebases.

On the data side I owned a PostgreSQL model, partitioned the invoices table and tuned queries to reduce p95 API latency from 900 ms to 180 ms. This performance focus complements the routing tools you are developing and ensures responsive service under load.

My front‑end work includes React and TypeScript dashboards used daily by 600 warehouse operators, delivering clear, real‑time insights. I have also contributed to payment and logistics products in Python and TypeScript, giving me practical domain knowledge that translates well to courier routing challenges. Continuous‑integration pipelines built with Docker, GitHub Actions, Prometheus and Grafana keep releases reliable and observable.

I am eager to apply this blend of backend, database, and UI expertise to help Tally Logistics ship robust routing tools for couriers, and I look forward to discussing how my background can contribute to your team’s success.
